messages:
Anya: quick heads up — I'm trying to onboard the new 1.2B-slim model. weights uploaded to gs://redwood-models/onboard/1.2b-slim-v2/sha256:ab12... but load is failing in dedicated staging.
Ben: what failure are you seeing? logs?
Anya: getting OOM during init on a 48GB A100; stack shows failure in allocator while mapping the sharded checkpoints. full snippet:
```
E tensorflow/stream_executor/cuda/cuda_driver.cc:xxxx] failed to allocate 8.3G (CUDA OOM)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/runtime/loader.py", line 142, in load_weights
    map_shards(...)
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory while mapping shards
```
Carlos: hmm — is this the sharded checkpoint layout or a single-file .pt?
Anya: it's sharded: model-00001-of-00008.bin ... I suspect our mmap logic is trying to map combined size rather than per-shard. Also tokenizer outputs look off in a quick eval — many UNK tokens where they shouldn't be.
Sree: do you have tokenizer files in the same bucket? sometimes missing vocab.json leads to fallback to simple tokenizer
Anya: yes: gs://redwood-models/onboard/1.2b-slim-v2/tokenizer/{vocab.json,merges.txt,tokenizer_config.json}
Ben: can you paste the tokenizer version header from tokenizer_config.json? we accidentally uploaded a GPT2 tokenizer for another model earlier.
Anya: tokenizer_config.json shows "tokenizer_class": "SentencePieceBPETokenizer", "version": "0.1.0" — but the tokenizer binary we ship expects spm model, not BPE; mismatch possible.
Carlos: that explains bad outputs + lots of <unk>. For OOM: are we starting with max_seq_length 4096 by default? if so the kv cache allocation could blow up during warmup.
Anya: loader config used max_seq_length: 8192 (my mistake) — should be 2048 for this model. patching now.
deploy-bot: Started restart of staging-gpu-pool for project onboard-1.2b (requested by Anya)
Ben: two actionable items: 1) fix tokenizer files (convert to expected spm) and re-upload; 2) change loader config to max_seq_length 2048 and enable lazy_kv_cache=true to avoid prealloc.
Sree: addition: run the tokenizer-diff tool against the prod tokenizer to confirm vocab mapping changes. command:
```
python tools/tokenizer_diff.py --left gs://prod-models/1.2b/tokenizer --right gs://redwood-models/onboard/1.2b-slim-v2/tokenizer
```
Anya: running diff now. also adding checksum file next to shards: sha256sum *.bin > CHECKSUMS.txt
Anya: (results) tokenizer_diff shows 97% token overlap but 3 tokens remapped -> should cause some degenerate outputs earlier. uploading fixed tokenizer and updated config.
Carlos: after config change did the OOM persist?
Anya: restart completed, staged load now succeeds on a single A100 with lazy_kv_cache enabled. quick smoke prompts look normal.
Ben: great. can you open a short PR with the loader config change and a note in the onboarding checklist about tokenizer format + checksum?
Anya: will do. PR coming in a sec. assigning follow-ups: Ben — add a validation step in the upload pipeline to reject tokenizer format mismatch; Sree — add tokenizer-diff to model onboarding CI; Carlos — validate shard mmap behavior under lower memory.
deploy-bot: PR 4827 created by Anya: "onboard: fix max_seq_length, enable lazy_kv_cache, add checksum"
Ben: thanks — leaving a :thumbsup: on the PR. moving to post-incident doc in #postmortems once PR merges.
Anya: thanks all, saved us from a prod rollout. :relieved:
